value.rationale: The full-coalescence hitting time from all occupied sites is a standard and motivated interacting-particle statistic. The result moves beyond previously proved order Theta(log b), giving both exact finite law and a non-classical order-one fluctuation law. This identifies an influence of repeated hub excursions not captured by naive independent exponential maxima, with a sharp variance distinct from Gumbel.
